en: The Chapter on Similes, Section on the Ants.
3. The Question of the Rat “Venerable Nāgasena, when you say that ‘one quality of a rat should be adopted,’ which is that one quality that should be adopted?
“Just as, Great King, a rat, while wandering here and there, goes about solely seeking food;”
In the same way, Great King, a yogin practicing yoga who wanders here and there must be one who relies upon wise attention (*yoniso manasikāra*).
This, Great King, is one quality to be adopted from the mouse.
And this, Great King, was said by the Elder Upasena Vaṅgantaputta:
Thus ends the third question concerning the far-reaching stride.
